verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security SaaS platform, so data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature, no open-format downloads, and no offboarding or data-portability process. The MCP server and service keys allow agents to interact with a workspace, but nothing shows they support bulk extraction of all data. The "nothing is locked in" line refers only to editable MDM policy defaults, not to data portability.
